mentions.name: tools-ts (tool.io)
mentions.description: An open-source library of functional software tools for developers, their apps, and AI agents, aiming to be a 'Wikipedia for functional software tools' so people can use shared tools instead of recreating small ones; contributors can create and publish their own tools via GitHub. Currently in alpha prerelease, with a web app and CLI coming soon.
mentions.problem: Small functional software tools are endlessly recreated instead of being reused from a shared library.
mentions.audience: Small functional software tools are endlessly recreated instead of being reused from a shared library.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a tool library for you, your apps and AI agents, it is on Github but super early though (alpha prerelease, web app and CLI etc coming very soon)

https://github.com/tool-io/tools-ts

The goal of https://tool.io is to be a Wikipedia but for functional software tools.
